test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held on: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A place where airplanes are kept for maintenance
solution: The correct answer is "Hangar." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ __ • The word** "hangar" **means a big building where planes are kept. (विमान को रखने की इमारत; हैंगर) • **Example**:* These trials led to the domes' ultimate tests, in the role of portable aircraft **hangars**__.* • **Hangars** are essential infrastructure at airports and military bases, serving as a secure and weather-resistant environment for airplanes when they are not in use. • Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 3. ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ • **Hanger: **a metal, plastic or wooden object with a hook that is used for hanging up clothes in a cupboard. (अलमारी में कपड़े टाँगने के लिए प्रयुक्त धातु, प्‍लास्टिक या लकड़ी का बना घुंडीदार छड़ी-नुमा वस्‍तु; हैंगर) • **Scullery: **a small kitchen or room at the back of a house used for washing dishes and other dirty household work. (घर के पीछे एक छोटी रसोई या कमरा जिसका उपयोग बर्तन धोने और अन्य गंदे घरेलू काम के लिए किया जाता है) • **Aviary: **a large cage or area in which birds are kept. (पक्षीशाला, दरबा) 12d:Tae2, Here, the erroneous part is "get extreme cold."
